name: starter
description: Minimal template plugin for the codex-plugins marketplace.

interface.longDescription: A copy-me template for building Codex plugins: one .codex-plugin/plugin.json manifest and one skill. Use it to verify that the codex-plugins marketplace is wired up correctly, then copy the folder to start your own plugin.
defaultPrompt: Run hello-codex to check this plugin is installed correctly.
